description: Repository class for managing Announcement entities in the Goteo project, including methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting announcements.

classes.name: AnnouncementRepository
classes.description: Repository class for handling database operations related to announcements in the Goteo platform.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches an announcement by its ID.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total number of announcements.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of announcements with pagination.

methods.name: getActiveList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of active announcements with pagination.

methods.name: getActiveWithoutDonationList
methods.description: Retrieves active announcements excluding those of type donation.

methods.name: persist
methods.description: Creates or updates an announcement based on its ID.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Inserts a new announcement into the database.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing announcement in the database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an announcement from the database.
